M08: paper trading — Broker ABC, Alpaca paper adapter, mock + Trading212 stub, rebalancer, reconcile, journal, runner, promotion gate (loop: 4 dev iters, review APPROVE/REVISE/APPROVE/APPROVE, quant-gate REJECT, REJECT, ACCEPT — cycle 3 approved by Alex)

- paper/{broker,mock,trading212,rebalancer,reconcile,journal,runner,alpaca}.py; `quantlab paper run/status/journal/rebaseline`; docs/paper-trading.md
- Alpaca paper-only by construction (NotPaperAccountError on any other endpoint; env-only credentials)
- shared backtest/context.py build_decision_context used by BOTH run_backtest and run_once (filtering
  provider, max_dropped_fraction abort, blend per-child factory) — runner targets byte-identical to the engine
- proactive actions-cache refresh driven by sidecar fetched_at over the declared universe + held tickers
  (gate-verified to introduce no look-ahead), reactive retry as second line
- reconcile rolls the expected baseline through dividends/splits; journaled manual rebaseline; refuses on
  unexplained mismatch before any order
- unpriceable held tickers force-exited and journaled; partial fills topped up (attempt ids, cancel resting,
  DUPLICATE acks); structural exactly-one-journal-record guarantee with stage; guarded account fetch
- promotion gate keyed on strategy_id + DATA_SEMANTICS_VERSION; --force-research leaves a loud flag
- canary (k): asof = last completed session AND <= last cached bar; 690 offline tests (network tier skipped)
- carried to M09: --dry-run is a second decide-and-plan path (must fix); drift check; data refresh CLI

  separate selection effects, extreme counts with direction, known_caveats, rolling first-return-blind
  convention, no_cliff_score never as quality, walk-forward no-embargo + "not retained/not checked",
  execution conventions incl. next_open entry price, Sharpe/Sortino conventions, DSR non-monotonicity,
  N dedup / raw / dirty, K, RC/SPA benchmark source + measured over-sizing constant, capacity
  trivial-pass + old-repo $95M–$335M reference, the two informational lines, verdict/gate legend)
- HTML autoescape ON with only static carried-note literals marked safe (review caught vendor ticker
  strings reaching gate reasons); markdown env plain text
- gate caught a transposed walk-forward table certified by a hand-written fixture; now fed by the real
  serialiser, plus chosen-weight and sensitivity tables in both formats, visible plot-failure cells,
  --config seed passthrough, four rendered verdict fixtures under plans/state/M07/fixtures

- validation/{registry,deflated_sharpe,purged_cv,bootstrap,monte_carlo,reality_check,capacity,report_card}.py
- registry keyed on (strategy_id, data_semantics_version, backtest_config_hash); trials
  deduplicated by return-series hash; trial variance floored at the per-period null 1/(n−1);
  SR* = 0 only at N = 1; the "over-counting is conservative" claim removed
- PSR/DSR/MinTRL on the per-period footing (review caught annualised SR × raw n: an
  order-of-magnitude gate loosening); scipy method-of-moments skew/kurt

  decision; genuine refit-per-fold CV carried post-v1)
- RC/SPA over the full-key trial matrix, embedded benchmark by default, (1+count)/(B+1)
  p-values, pairwise overlap resolver with the headline pinned (never removable; TrialMatrixError
  with reason_kind), size-bound calibration test at the shipped block length
- report card: hard/soft gates from configs/validation.yaml only; provenance (dirty, N vs raw,
  K, benchmark source, retained fraction, conventions); DSR non-monotonicity and capacity
  trivial-pass disclosures; ELIGIBLE_FOR_PAPER reachable through the real CLI (sensitivity grid
  via the engine, historical trials seeded, walk-forward for blends)
- 533 offline tests green (~25 s)

Merge M04b engine perf + data quality (quant-gate ACCEPT cycle 2)

M04b: calendar bounds pinned, negative price cache with TTL, run-level panel/actions/facts stores, QualityGate wired with quarantine + symbol-reuse detectors, unscored self-reported (loop: 2 dev iters, review APPROVE x2, quant-gate REJECT then ACCEPT)

- core/calendar.py: XNYS bounds pinned 1990-01-01..2040-12-31 (was a moving 20-year window);
  pit.py window clamp; benchmark read from the store (the 2006 DateOutOfBounds crash)
- negative price cache: no_data sidecar with fetched_at + retry_after_days (PlatformConfig);
  parquet always wins over sidecar on read and write (gate finding 1)
- backtest/panel_store.py: universe loaded once per run; PITDataContext(panel_store=...) slices
  with the same hard <= asof gate; every lookahead canary parametrised over provider/store paths;
  hostile store rows never reach a strategy; per-run actions memo + EDGAR facts cache
- data/quality.py wired at the read boundary: quarantined tickers serve zero rows (fail closed);
  scan_price_cache: padding-aware zero-volume (hard 0.5 bar or implausible level), action-excused
  jumps (±3 sessions, >=3 to quarantine), symbol-reuse-across-gap, membership-based reuse
  (first bar later than BOTH requested_start and the latest membership span by >400 sessions →
  one re-fetch → quarantine); masked_start mirrors masked_end in survivorship
- real cache scanned: 47 quarantined (42 in the momentum universe) — Yahoo reissues delisted
  symbols and erases the old history (EQR/AVB/EA/LEG 2026-07-17; APC, FB, SPLS, ...);
  TIE/BMC/CBE/PTV/CPWR/MEE interleave two companies' bars
- TargetWeights.unscored self-reported by momentum/value/blend; engine no longer infers
  universe − holdings (median 473 → 87 per rebalance)
- adjustment.py / corporate_actions.py perf (numerics byte-identical: 300 + 1200 randomised
  differential trials at review and gate); provenance.run_seconds + provenance.dirty
- full 2012–2026 momentum run: 45 min + crash → 8m32s; provisional one-liner net CAGR 17.66%
  / Sharpe 0.98 / maxDD −23.25% / coverage bound 28.4% (reconciliation vs old repo → M09)
- 492 offline tests green
